questions.explanation: 原文: "I chose a really nice pale colour, and I'll have cushions to match. ... Exactly. I ordered some online - they'll arrive tomorrow." 解析: 女孩说她选择了浅色的墙壁，并且订购了靠垫来搭配，靠垫明天到，所以答案是A。
